text: At its meeting held March 29-31, 2023, City Council appointed Dan Zilnik to the TAF Board for a term of office from April 3, 2023 to March 31, 2027 and until a successor is appointed. This new appointment fills the position previously held by Antoine Belaieff whose term has ended effective as of April 2, 2023.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
